data.one_liner: Show native incoming and outgoing call screens with Callkit on iOS and custom UI on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to display native incoming call interfaces (Callkit on iOS and custom UI on Android), handle VoIP push notifications, start outgoing calls, and manage call states.
use_when: You are building a VoIP or calling application and need native lock-screen call UI.
You need to handle PushKit notifications for incoming calls on iOS.
avoid_when: You are testing incoming VoIP calls on an iOS simulator (requires a real device).
Your app does not involve voice or video calls.
strengths: Integrates native Callkit on iOS and custom incoming screens on Android.
Supports Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods.
Provides stream events for all call actions like accept, decline, and timeout.
weaknesses: iOS Callkit features do not work fully on simulators and require real devices.
Requires manual native configuration for PushKit, permissions, and app delegates.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml, Info.plist for VoIP background modes, handling PushKit on iOS, and setting up specific permissions for Android 13/14.
